title: Battle of In-Delimane (2012)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of In-Delimane (2012)", at revision 1370443727, opens: "The Battle of Idelimane took place during the Internal Conflict in Azawad." Wikidata item Q15231507, whose own description reads "2012 battle". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
